task: B06 bounded chunked JSON archive pure library
integrity: SHA-256 per chunk and complete key
Canonical manifest hash binds metadata, per-key bytes/hash, chunk index/length/hash/count
Ordered key manifest and chunk sequence
Reject duplicate JSON object members, including escaped member names
Reject missing/extra/duplicate/tampered chunks, unsupported format/schema, undeclared fields
Reject credentials, unsafe keys, internal recovery and migration state without silent dropping
Reject invalid lone UTF16 surrogates; preserve valid Unicode pairs and all string values

verification.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node --skipLibCheck src/lib/core/backup-archive.ts src/lib/core/backup-archive.test.ts

limitations: Full JSON string and parsed container held in memory; not streaming or unlimited. Browser allocation limits may fail below declared maximum.
Hashes detect corruption, not malicious authorship/authentication.
Caller must obtain consistent durable records and accurate scope/exclusions; this library neither accesses storage nor proves isolation.
Caller should check File.size against BACKUP_ARCHIVE_MAX_JSON_BYTES before file.text().
UI/export/import integration and full project suite remain root task responsibility.
